sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rahul Bharti, Judge
 Order

By virtue of final award no. DCS/LAS/NH/2014 dated 12.01.2015, the Collector Land Acquisition, Assistant Commissioner (Revenue), Samba came to acquire 12.14 kanals of land situated in village Chann Matlooni, tehsil Ghagwal, district Samba.
In this 12.14 kanals of acquired land, the petitioners' land also forms part of the land acquisition which has been carried out under the J&K Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1996.
Section 4 notification came to be issued in September, 2009 whereas final award came to be passed after more than five years on 12.01.2015.

The grievance which the petitioners here is that till date not even a penny of compensation has been paid to them for the acquired land, as a result whereof the entire acquisition proceedings gets the hit of section 24 (2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
